title: (Tai) Khün alphabet, pronunciation and language
text: Khün is a member of the southwesetern Tai branch of the Kra-Dai or Tai-Kaidai language family. It is spoken in mainly eastern Myanmar, and also in southern China, northern Laos and northern Thailand by about 116,880 people.

title: Tai Ya language
text: Tai Ya (ISO 639-3: cuu) is classified as a member of the Kra-Dai language family, specifically within the Southwestern Tai subgroup of the Tai branch.
